thread:
eli: Rolled out tokenizer prefix-cache + adaptive-batching v1 to prod on /v1/generate for rw-medium-v2. Quick summary: p50 latency -18%, 99th unchanged, token cost -12%. Monitoring looks clean. :tada:

maria: Nice! Any risk of regression for long context (8k+)?

eli: Good question. We gated adaptive-batching on seq_len < 4096 and fallback to previous path for long requests. Tokenizer prefix-cache hits were ~72% on steady traffic which is where most savings came from.

sam: Can you paste the perf numbers and the rollout command? Want to add to release notes.

eli: Perf snapshot (prod 10-min aggregate after rollout):

```
rw-medium-v2 @ /v1/generate
- p50 latency: 82ms -> 67ms (-18%)
- p90 latency: 210ms -> 195ms (-7%)
- p99 latency: 670ms -> 665ms (-1%)
- tokens/sec per GPU: 1,120 -> 1,250 (+11%)
- estimated token cost/unit: $0.009 -> $0.0079 (-12%)
- tokenizer prefix-cache hitrate: 72%
- adaptive-batching avg batch size: 6 -> 9
```

eli: Rollout command we used (deploy-bot logs):

```
deploy-bot: deploy --service=inference --model=rw-medium-v2 --config=adaptive-batch+token-cache@canary --traffic=10%
# then 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 40m with health checks
```

kevin: Nice. Any changes to KV cache invalidation TTLs? I remember a diff that reduced TTL for short-lived prefixes.

eli: TTL unchanged for KV root, but we introduced a small LRU window for per-request prefixes (evict after 30s idle) to avoid growing memory on spikey prompts. Haven't seen evictions affecting hitrate yet.

maria: Did we run evals on the prompt suite? Any semantic regressions?

eli: Ran the eval harness on the core QA & summarization suites. No statistically-significant regressions; a couple prompts changed tokenization but normalized outputs are equivalent. I logged the eval run: https://ci.internal/runs/4782 (PR #4142).

sam: Ops/alerts? Anything to watch for overnight?

eli: Watch the cache eviction rate and p99 tail. If p99 climbs by >10% for 15m, we'll rollback the adaptive-batching flag. Alert created under channel #eng-oncall by deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: Alert rule created: runtime.adaptive_batching.p99 > baseline*1.10 for 15m -> notify eng-oncall. Rule id: AB-2026-12

kevin: Thanks. Also adding a short blurb to the changelog and a note to the Optimize team to update quant/pack recommendations.

maria: Sweet. Great win, ppl. :rocket:

eli: Will push a brief post to #announcements after we stabilize for 4h. If anyone sees oddness ping me directly.
